lore: A short book about building in halves of halves of halves.
use: The Simple Octets Guide explains the octets, mixed cells and melon octets. Craft it shapeless from a book and a stonecutter.
secret: Its pages open in your language and nothing is consumed.

lore: {name}: an eighth of a block, cut clean.
use: The Shapecutter cuts 8 octets from one full block of the material (without Simple Blocks the stonecutter does). 8 octets of one material craft back into the block. Up to eight fill one block cell.
secret: Octets of different materials share a cell; it remembers the material of each one.

lore: A melon slice that decided to become architecture.
use: Sneak and right-click a block with a melon slice to place it as a melon octet; without sneaking you eat the slice. Each octet drops one melon slice.
secret: The cell shows rind outside and flesh on the cut faces.
